title: Menemen
instructions: Chop onion and bell pepper, fry in olive oil. Add chopped tomato and cook until soft. Crack the eggs in, stir gently, season with salt and black pepper.

title: Tomato Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta. Fry garlic in olive oil, add chopped tomato and tomato paste, simmer 10 minutes. Mix with pasta and top with basil.

title: Omelette with Cheese
instructions: Beat eggs with milk and salt. Melt butter in a pan, pour eggs, add cheese, fold and serve.

title: Red Lentil Soup
instructions: Fry onion and carrot in olive oil, add tomato paste and lentils, cover with water and cook 25 minutes. Blend and squeeze lemon.

title: Chicken and Rice
instructions: Brown chicken pieces with onion and garlic, add rice and water, cook covered for 20 minutes.

title: Potato Omelette
instructions: Fry sliced potato and onion in olive oil until soft. Pour beaten eggs over and cook both sides.

title: Banana Pancakes
instructions: Mash banana, mix with egg, milk and flour. Cook small pancakes in butter. Serve with honey.

title: Yogurt Cucumber Salad (Cacik)
instructions: Grate cucumber, mix with yogurt, garlic and a little water. Add olive oil on top.
